whyItMatters.title: Why you need a learner's licence
whyItMatters.description: A learner's licence confirms that you understand the road rules, signs and basic vehicle control before driving on public roads.
whyItMatters.validity: Valid for 24 months and cannot be extended.

categories.label: Code 1
categories.ageRequirement: 16+ for motorcycles up to 125 cc, 18+ for above 125 cc

categories.label: Code 8
categories.vehicleType: Light motor vehicle up to 3,500 kg

requiredDocuments: Proof of postal and residential address
Affidavit if utility bill is not in your name
Ward councillor letter for informal settlement address (where applicable)
formsAndChecks: Complete the LL1 learner's licence application form
Medical certificate (MC) if 65 years or older
Eye test at a DLTC or qualified optometrist
testDayChecklist: Arrive early and follow examiner instructions
applicationChannels: Book online via NATIS where available
